contract: For one preregistered selection seed, run vanilla ASGD at all nine paper learning rates and Clipped ASGD at the Cartesian product of all nine learning rates and four clipping radii, using real label-skew CIFAR-10, Algorithm 2, and the exact 8,000-time-unit D=4 cap.
selection_rule: Within each method, select the smallest first 70%-accuracy hit time. A run without a hit is censored at the paper cap and cannot win.
non_circularity: No configuration is pruned and the event budget comes from the paper, not an observed or predicted result.
negative_control: The initialized model must remain below 70%.
terminal_claim_verdict: BLOCKED pending D=8 and independent winner repeats.
